title: Hexus Salts Blueberry Ice Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Blueberry Ice by Hexus delivers a clean, fruity vape with a brisk, cooling exhale. The Blueberry flavour is smooth and juicy, offering a mild sweetness that feels rounded and mellow. A streak of cool Ice cuts through the fruit with refreshing clarity, creating a simple but satisfying blend that’s ideal for everyday use. Made with nicotine salts, this e-liquid provides fast-acting nicotine relief with a tactile yet smooth throat hit. It’s blended at a 50VG/50PG ratio, making it perfect for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping using low-powered refillable pod kits and starter devices . The Hexus Nic Salt collection offers a wide variety of fruit, menthol and mixed blends in 10mg and 20mg strengths, designed for MTL vapers who want flavour and satisfaction in one.
